title: MECHANICS:FUND ＆ APPLICATIONS
description: Basic non-Euclidean coordinate systems, Newtonian Mechanics, oscillations, Greens functions, Newtonian graviation, Lagrangian mechanics, central force motion, two-body collisions, noninertial reference frames, rigid body dynamics. Applications, including GPS and feedback control systems, are emphasized throughout
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( PHYS UN1402 ) and ( MATH UN2030 ) or MATH V2030 AND PHYS C1402 ; or equivalent.
